Skeleton: PILOT- KIDNAPPING ACT 1 New ATOMICORP graduate Berny walks into a seemingly empty ship. She is in awe until she sees a stranger lounging in the captains chair. She tells him this area is restricted, academy property. He doesn't seem to get it. His name is Buddy. She thinks he's a bum off the streets and begins insulting him and his handling of the ship. She explains she has spent her entire life going through rigorous training to command this vessel and her mentor was an ATOMICORP executive and was about to assign her to it. All of her hard work was about to pay off. He seems unaware of her hostility and thinks what she's saying is cool. Her mentor, Pearl, comes in. Berny code-switches and sweetly and professionally greets her. Buddy says "hi mom!" Berny is silently horrified at the realization this is her mentor's son, and horrified by how she spoke to him. He innocently parrots back some of her admonishments to Pearl (your filthy gloves shouldn't be anywhere near that console). Pearl brushes these off and hands him the keys to the ship. He’s the captain and she's excited to make Berny his second in command. Berny is horrified. TITLE Berny tries make peace with this situation while preparing Buddy for the mission. He's in an all-over face mask & robe spa getup. Buddy's manny, Ed, tries comforting her by telling her the simple joys of caring for Buddy, even if the pay isn't great. He also asks many logistical questions about the ship and shift schedule (overprotective, seemingly micromanagerial trait). but it just makes her frightened people will always consider her Buddy's nanny instead of a qualified fleet commander. She freaks out. Berny asks Pearl what she did wrong and how she can get promoted. Pearl argues that this is the best use of her training. Berny politely insists she's not like the women who are trained to be stewardesses or caretakers. Pearl tells her that this job is a test run for her. Pearl knows Buddy is not the brightest, but Berny will be a good influence on him. She mentions how pleased she's been with Ed the past month he's been working for her. Pearl is sending them on a cushy mission to sell water and promote their new waterpark. If Berny just needs to keeps Buddy safe and out of trouble on this mission. He's a popular target for kidnappers looking for easy hostage money. If Berny can manage that, Pearl will arrange a meeting with an agent looking to take her. ACT 2 Berny comes out of her meeting with a newfound determination to make sure nothing bad happens to Buddy. The mission begins. The crew is sent to sell water to displaced refugees of a planet-wide drought outside the gates of Atomicorp's new waterpark. Buddy wants to talk to and help the refugees, but Berny won't allow it. Buddy wants to give them water but Berny wont allow it unless they pay. Ed says he promised Buddy they could walk around the slums. Buddy says he's excited to be a do-gooder and take care of ruffians or bandits that could be about. but Berny vetoes this plan. A refugee says all of their money was taken by bandits. Berny does not care and instead asks for someone with money. She has hired a soldier, Trooper, who points a gun at potential new friends. Ed suggests Berny let Buddy have more of a role and tells him to talk to the next refugee in line. One refugee says he feels incoming heat stroke and needs a cooling pad. Buddy offers to let him in the ship to use his cooling spa contraption. Berny shuts this down and scares the refugee off, to Buddy's dismay. Ed says Berny should encourage Buddy's independence but Berny says all that matters to her is his safety. Buddy runs back into the ship, crying, and Ed goes after him. Another refugee comes up and says if they're still offering to take care of bandits, they've had a huge problem recently. Berny ignores him. Back in the ship, Ed encourages Buddy not to listen to Berny. Buddy doesn't want to break her rules, but Ed points out how little she's letting him do, and how he's just as cooped up on the mission as he was at home. Ed says he managed to contact the refugee and invite him back onto the ship. Buddy agrees to use a back entrance to sneakily invite the refugee and his friends into the ship. Once they get on, they take off their rags, and start talking to Ed like this was pre-arranged. "Six way split?" Berny voices her frustrations with this situation to Trooper, who accidentally ticks her off to an important realization that Ed is not who he says he is. Berny asks why Trooper didn’t join them. Trooper says Ed told her to stay with Berny. Berny is offended Trooper is listening to Ed instead of her, a commanding officer. Trooper says Ed showed a Vehicle command authority card. Berny realizes that’s incompatible with his tutor role. Just then, Ed runs back from the ship, yelling for help. Berny commands trooper to apprehend him instead. She gets trooper to search his pockets and a bunch of forged id cards drop out. She interrogates him about his real identity. He drops his act and gloats about it all, then smugly lets her know that she should be more worried that Buddy has just been kidnapped and is being held ransom. He says that this group can get rowdy, so if Berny is so concerned about Buddy's safety, she should really call Pearl and let her know about the emergency. His comm pad is already ringing. Berny takes Ed's comm pad and responds to Pearl while Trooper muffles Ed. Before Berny can say anything, Pearl tells her she scheduled for the recruiter to visit them on the job. Ed is surprised when, instead of telling Pearl and calling in reinforcements, Berny collects herself and assures her that everything is going fantastic. Ed insists Berny is not going to be able to fix this situation herself, and his colleages won't give Buddy up without an armada of atomicorp drones, but Berny cites the manual on hostage situations and advanced interrogation methods. She orders Trooper to consult the page and get the information out of him through torture. ACT 3 The recruiter has arrived and Berny tries to keep her from seeing that something has gone wrong. Makes excuses to keep her outside in the heat, uses up all of their water to keep her comfortable, pisses off the crowd of refugees. Berny moves her under the shade of the ship. The recruiter tells her about the job she's offering (Berny's dream job). She is very pleased with Berny at first but starts to get more and more annoyed. The refugee from earlier comes up from the crowd and thanks Berny for giving them the water and makes her look good in front of the recruiter but also takes the rest of the water. Meanwhile, back by the ship, Trooper is trying to threaten/torture Ed for the code to get inside. Ed refuses to betray his colleagues in the face of pain. Trooper accidentally reveals Berny is authourizied to offer Ed a permanant contract and raise. Ed learns he would make more with his raise working for Buddy than he would make from ransoming Buddy. He immediately sells them out and gives Trooper the door keycode. Buddy is wearing down the kidnappers and asking questions. He’s so excited to be on a real adventure. Trooper barges in and turns the situation immediately over the top and violent. In the chaos, Buddy tries to trigger the emergency hatch. The recruiter sees the ship malfunctioning and hears the gunshots. She moves towards the ship, threatening to ruin Berny's career for letting things get this bad. Berny is on her knees begging to make things right. Then, the recruiter is killed by the emergency ship ladder Buddy accidentally deployed. Berny is horrified, on her knees next to the dead recruiter when the crew comes down the escape hatch of the ship. Hard cut to the crew recounting this story to Pearl/a council. They're asked to tell the full truth. Ed and Berny nod to each other. They say The kidnappers attacked the ship. Trooper eliminated them. Berny coordinated the rescue. The recruiter died in the crossfire. Buddy corroborates this as the best adventure he's had. They are given medals. The refugee who tried to warn them about bandits watches. Button scene, Pearl congratulates Berny but holds off on the promotion reassessment for another year. 2. Military Base Feminism Requirements: Unethical Mission: The crew needs to either transport a singer or infiltrate a prostitution ring Thematic Argument: Don't let the boxes the military sorts women into prevent you from finding solidarity. Berny is a big fan of the general, who is Trooper's dad. Trooper is also a big fan of her dad. Ed is dressed for vacation. He has an ex from here. (innocent as a lily flower), but she couldn't resist him. Does Berny want to join the general's crew? TITLE First impression of the general. Tries to have a one on one "girl talk." waits in Trooper's room in the dark until she gets back to corner her. She says "women need to have each others backs. What's important is that neither of us are prostitutes." Trooper reasserts that Berny doesn't get it because she's a girl. Buddy tries to comfort a sniffling Ed. Ed explains it’s not embarrassing for him to have slept with the prostitute, he just miscalculated the points he got from it. It's not impressive to have sex with a prostitute. He ranks the status of each role a woman has on the military base and how impressive it is to have sex with them numerically. Ed decides he needs to sleep with someone higher status on the base to impress the general. What does Ed want from the general? Berny does something bad to prostitutes. Some quick Ed and Buddy foreshadowing Berny does something to disproportionately humiliate and immasculate Trooper. She gets Trooper's dad to say she's like the daughter he never had. What is this humiliation? ACT 3 Berny is pleased that Trooper is being obedient in front of others and allowing her to social climb. What is the thing that happens? It is revealed Buddy slept with a General’s wife and the general is trying to throw down. Trooper does not succeed in throwing down and instead cowers away. Ed and Buddy yell at Berny to fix whatever is going on with Trooper. Berny thinks the prostitutes will cheer her up but they refuse to help her because of something she did to them earlier. What did berny do to the prostitutes? Berny humiliates herself by dressing like one of the prostitutes on the base needing Trooper to rescue her. Trooper bounces back in confidence and gives a beatdown to whoever they needed her to beat down. who does trooper need to beat up? from earlier? *** ### 3. docs.text: PILOT- KIDNAPPING ACT 1 New ATOMICORP graduate Berny walks into a seemingly empty ship. She is in awe until she sees a stranger lounging in the captains chair. She tells him this area is restricted, academy property. He doesn't seem to get it. His name is Buddy. She thinks he's a bum off the streets and begins insulting him and his handling of the ship. She explains she has spent her entire life going through rigorous training to command this vessel and her mentor was an ATOMICORP executive and was about to assign her to it. All of her hard work was about to pay off. He seems unaware of her hostility and thinks what she's saying is cool. Her mentor, Pearl, comes in. Berny code-switches and sweetly and professionally greets her. Buddy says "hi mom!" Berny is silently horrified at the realization this is her mentor's son, and horrified by how she spoke to him. He innocently parrots back some of her admonishments to Pearl (your filthy gloves shouldn't be anywhere near that console). Pearl brushes these off and hands him the keys to the ship. He’s the captain and she's excited to make Berny his second in command. Berny is horrified. TITLE Berny tries make peace with this situation while preparing Buddy for the mission. He's in an all-over face mask & robe spa getup. Buddy's manny, Ed, tries comforting her by telling her the simple joys of caring for Buddy, even if the pay isn't great. He also asks many logistical questions about the ship and shift schedule (overprotective, seemingly micromanagerial trait). but it just makes her frightened people will always consider her Buddy's nanny instead of a qualified fleet commander. She freaks out. Berny asks Pearl what she did wrong and how she can get promoted. Pearl argues that this is the best use of her training. Berny politely insists she's not like the women who are trained to be stewardesses or caretakers. Pearl tells her that this job is a test run for her. Pearl knows Buddy is not the brightest, but Berny will be a good influence on him. She mentions how pleased she's been with Ed the past month he's been working for her. Pearl is sending them on a cushy mission to sell water and promote their new waterpark. If Berny just needs to keeps Buddy safe and out of trouble on this mission. He's a popular target for kidnappers looking for easy hostage money. If Berny can manage that, Pearl will arrange a meeting with an agent looking to take her. ACT 2 Berny comes out of her meeting with a newfound determination to make sure nothing bad happens to Buddy. The mission begins. The crew is sent to sell water to displaced refugees of a planet-wide drought outside the gates of Atomicorp's new waterpark. Buddy wants to talk to and help the refugees, but Berny won't allow it. Buddy wants to give them water but Berny wont allow it unless they pay. Ed says he promised Buddy they could walk around the slums. Buddy says he's excited to be a do-gooder and take care of ruffians or bandits that could be about. but Berny vetoes this plan. A refugee says all of their money was taken by bandits. Berny does not care and instead asks for someone with money. She has hired a soldier, Trooper, who points a gun at potential new friends. Ed suggests Berny let Buddy have more of a role and tells him to talk to the next refugee in line. One refugee says he feels incoming heat stroke and needs a cooling pad. Buddy offers to let him in the ship to use his cooling spa contraption. Berny shuts this down and scares the refugee off, to Buddy's dismay. Ed says Berny should encourage Buddy's independence but Berny says all that matters to her is his safety. Buddy runs back into the ship, crying, and Ed goes after him. Another refugee comes up and says if they're still offering to take care of bandits, they've had a huge problem recently. Berny ignores him. Back in the ship, Ed encourages Buddy not to listen to Berny. Buddy doesn't want to break her rules, but Ed points out how little she's letting him do, and how he's just as cooped up on the mission as he was at home. Ed says he managed to contact the refugee and invite him back onto the ship. Buddy agrees to use a back entrance to sneakily invite the refugee and his friends into the ship. Once they get on, they take off their rags, and start talking to Ed like this was pre-arranged. "Six way split?" Berny voices her frustrations with this situation to Trooper, who accidentally ticks her off to an important realization that Ed is not who he says he is. Berny asks why Trooper didn’t join them. Trooper says Ed told her to stay with Berny. Berny is offended Trooper is listening to Ed instead of her, a commanding officer. Trooper says Ed showed a Vehicle command authority card. Berny realizes that’s incompatible with his tutor role. Just then, Ed runs back from the ship, yelling for help. Berny commands trooper to apprehend him instead. She gets trooper to search his pockets and a bunch of forged id cards drop out. She interrogates him about his real identity. He drops his act and gloats about it all, then smugly lets her know that she should be more worried that Buddy has just been kidnapped and is being held ransom. He says that this group can get rowdy, so if Berny is so concerned about Buddy's safety, she should really call Pearl and let her know about the emergency. His comm pad is already ringing. Berny takes Ed's comm pad and responds to Pearl while Trooper muffles Ed. Before Berny can say anything, Pearl tells her she scheduled for the recruiter to visit them on the job. Ed is surprised when, instead of telling Pearl and calling in reinforcements, Berny collects herself and assures her that everything is going fantastic. Ed insists Berny is not going to be able to fix this situation herself, and his colleages won't give Buddy up without an armada of atomicorp drones, but Berny cites the manual on hostage situations and advanced interrogation methods. She orders Trooper to consult the page and get the information out of him through torture. ACT 3 The recruiter has arrived and Berny tries to keep her from seeing that something has gone wrong. Makes excuses to keep her outside in the heat, uses up all of their water to keep her comfortable, pisses off the crowd of refugees. Berny moves her under the shade of the ship. The recruiter tells her about the job she's offering (Berny's dream job). She is very pleased with Berny at first but starts to get more and more annoyed. The refugee from earlier comes up from the crowd and thanks Berny for giving them the water and makes her look good in front of the recruiter but also takes the rest of the water. Meanwhile, back by the ship, Trooper is trying to threaten/torture Ed for the code to get inside. Ed refuses to betray his colleagues in the face of pain. Trooper accidentally reveals Berny is authourizied to offer Ed a permanant contract and raise. Ed learns he would make more with his raise working for Buddy than he would make from ransoming Buddy. He immediately sells them out and gives Trooper the door keycode. Buddy is wearing down the kidnappers and asking questions. He’s so excited to be on a real adventure. Trooper barges in and turns the situation immediately over the top and violent. In the chaos, Buddy tries to trigger the emergency hatch. The recruiter sees the ship malfunctioning and hears the gunshots. She moves towards the ship, threatening to ruin Berny's career for letting things get this bad. Berny is on her knees begging to make things right. Then, the recruiter is killed by the emergency ship ladder Buddy accidentally deployed. Berny is horrified, on her knees next to the dead recruiter when the crew comes down the escape hatch of the ship. Hard cut to the crew recounting this story to Pearl/a council. They're asked to tell the full truth. Ed and Berny nod to each other. They say The kidnappers attacked the ship. Trooper eliminated them. Berny coordinated the rescue. The recruiter died in the crossfire. Buddy corroborates this as the best adventure he's had. They are given medals. The refugee who tried to warn them about bandits watches. Button scene, Pearl congratulates Berny but holds off on the promotion reassessment for another year.

Research: Character Conflicts: Character Wants Flawed Strategy Creates Trouble For Berny Ed Buddy Trooper *** #### Story Spine: Scene Character Wants Conflict Pivot Skeleton: PILOT- KIDNAPPING ACT 1 New ATOMICORP graduate Berny walks into a seemingly empty ship. She is in awe until she sees a stranger lounging in the captains chair. She tells him this area is restricted, academy property. He doesn't seem to get it. His name is Buddy. She thinks he's a bum off the streets and begins insulting him and his handling of the ship. She explains she has spent her entire life going through rigorous training to command this vessel and her mentor was an ATOMICORP executive and was about to assign her to it. All of her hard work was about to pay off. He seems unaware of her hostility and thinks what she's saying is cool. Her mentor, Pearl, comes in. Berny code-switches and sweetly and professionally greets her. Buddy says "hi mom!" Berny is silently horrified at the realization this is her mentor's son, and horrified by how she spoke to him. He innocently parrots back some of her admonishments to Pearl (your filthy gloves shouldn't be anywhere near that console). Pearl brushes these off and hands him the keys to the ship. He’s the captain and she's excited to make Berny his second in command. Berny is horrified. TITLE Berny tries make peace with this situation while preparing Buddy for the mission. He's in an all-over face mask & robe spa getup. Buddy's manny, Ed, tries comforting her by telling her the simple joys of caring for Buddy, even if the pay isn't great. He also asks many logistical questions about the ship and shift schedule (overprotective, seemingly micromanagerial trait). but it just makes her frightened people will always consider her Buddy's nanny instead of a qualified fleet commander. She freaks out. Berny asks Pearl what she did wrong and how she can get promoted. Pearl argues that this is the best use of her training. Berny politely insists she's not like the women who are trained to be stewardesses or caretakers. Pearl tells her that this job is a test run for her. Pearl knows Buddy is not the brightest, but Berny will be a good influence on him. She mentions how pleased she's been with Ed the past month he's been working for her. Pearl is sending them on a cushy mission to sell water and promote their new waterpark. If Berny just needs to keeps Buddy safe and out of trouble on this mission. He's a popular target for kidnappers looking for easy hostage money. If Berny can manage that, Pearl will arrange a meeting with an agent looking to take her. ACT 2 Berny comes out of her meeting with a newfound determination to make sure nothing bad happens to Buddy. The mission begins. The crew is sent to sell water to displaced refugees of a planet-wide drought outside the gates of Atomicorp's new waterpark. Buddy wants to talk to and help the refugees, but Berny won't allow it. Buddy wants to give them water but Berny wont allow it unless they pay. Ed says he promised Buddy they could walk around the slums. Buddy says he's excited to be a do-gooder and take care of ruffians or bandits that could be about. but Berny vetoes this plan. A refugee says all of their money was taken by bandits. Berny does not care and instead asks for someone with money. She has hired a soldier, Trooper, who points a gun at potential new friends. Ed suggests Berny let Buddy have more of a role and tells him to talk to the next refugee in line. One refugee says he feels incoming heat stroke and needs a cooling pad. Buddy offers to let him in the ship to use his cooling spa contraption. Berny shuts this down and scares the refugee off, to Buddy's dismay. Ed says Berny should encourage Buddy's independence but Berny says all that matters to her is his safety. Buddy runs back into the ship, crying, and Ed goes after him. Another refugee comes up and says if they're still offering to take care of bandits, they've had a huge problem recently. Berny ignores him. Back in the ship, Ed encourages Buddy not to listen to Berny. Buddy doesn't want to break her rules, but Ed points out how little she's letting him do, and how he's just as cooped up on the mission as he was at home. Ed says he managed to contact the refugee and invite him back onto the ship. Buddy agrees to use a back entrance to sneakily invite the refugee and his friends into the ship. Once they get on, they take off their rags, and start talking to Ed like this was pre-arranged. "Six way split?" Berny voices her frustrations with this situation to Trooper, who accidentally ticks her off to an important realization that Ed is not who he says he is. Berny asks why Trooper didn’t join them. Trooper says Ed told her to stay with Berny. Berny is offended Trooper is listening to Ed instead of her, a commanding officer. Trooper says Ed showed a Vehicle command authority card. Berny realizes that’s incompatible with his tutor role. Just then, Ed runs back from the ship, yelling for help. Berny commands trooper to apprehend him instead. She gets trooper to search his pockets and a bunch of forged id cards drop out. She interrogates him about his real identity. He drops his act and gloats about it all, then smugly lets her know that she should be more worried that Buddy has just been kidnapped and is being held ransom. He says that this group can get rowdy, so if Berny is so concerned about Buddy's safety, she should really call Pearl and let her know about the emergency. His comm pad is already ringing. Berny takes Ed's comm pad and responds to Pearl while Trooper muffles Ed. Before Berny can say anything, Pearl tells her she scheduled for the recruiter to visit them on the job. Ed is surprised when, instead of telling Pearl and calling in reinforcements, Berny collects herself and assures her that everything is going fantastic. Ed insists Berny is not going to be able to fix this situation herself, and his colleages won't give Buddy up without an armada of atomicorp drones, but Berny cites the manual on hostage situations and advanced interrogation methods. She orders Trooper to consult the page and get the information out of him through torture. ACT 3 The recruiter has arrived and Berny tries to keep her from seeing that something has gone wrong. Makes excuses to keep her outside in the heat, uses up all of their water to keep her comfortable, pisses off the crowd of refugees. Berny moves her under the shade of the ship. The recruiter tells her about the job she's offering (Berny's dream job). She is very pleased with Berny at first but starts to get more and more annoyed. The refugee from earlier comes up from the crowd and thanks Berny for giving them the water and makes her look good in front of the recruiter but also takes the rest of the water. Meanwhile, back by the ship, Trooper is trying to threaten/torture Ed for the code to get inside. Ed refuses to betray his colleagues in the face of pain. Trooper accidentally reveals Berny is authourizied to offer Ed a permanant contract and raise. Ed learns he would make more with his raise working for Buddy than he would make from ransoming Buddy. He immediately sells them out and gives Trooper the door keycode. Buddy is wearing down the kidnappers and asking questions. He’s so excited to be on a real adventure. Trooper barges in and turns the situation immediately over the top and violent. In the chaos, Buddy tries to trigger the emergency hatch. The recruiter sees the ship malfunctioning and hears the gunshots. She moves towards the ship, threatening to ruin Berny's career for letting things get this bad. Berny is on her knees begging to make things right. Then, the recruiter is killed by the emergency ship ladder Buddy accidentally deployed. Berny is horrified, on her knees next to the dead recruiter when the crew comes down the escape hatch of the ship. Hard cut to the crew recounting this story to Pearl/a council. They're asked to tell the full truth. Ed and Berny nod to each other. They say The kidnappers attacked the ship. Trooper eliminated them. Berny coordinated the rescue. The recruiter died in the crossfire. Buddy corroborates this as the best adventure he's had. They are given medals. The refugee who tried to warn them about bandits watches. Button scene, Pearl congratulates Berny but holds off on the promotion reassessment for another year. Comic Opportunities, Open Questions:
